column1: # Snapshot of the SMART schema: table, column, DuckDB type[, SMART version that added it].
# Taken from a SMART 7.5.4 database (SMART Desktop 7.5.6) via JDBC metadata:
# the .columns sidecars DumpSmartDb writes, one line per column, in table
#   - check_schema.sh compares every extracted database or export against it
#     and warns about new, missing, or retyped tables and columns, so a newer
#     SMART version shows its deltas at extract time.
#   - export_to_csv.sh takes column types from it, because a Conservation Area
#     export has no types; a column not listed here is loaded as text.
# The rows with a version in the fourth column are later additions known from
# the SMART source, kept so they get a proper type when they appear.
# To refresh: ./smart-able extract a database of the new version, then
#   for f in work/csv/*.columns; do t=$(basename $f .columns); tr -d "{}'" < $f | tr ',' '\n' | sed 's/^ *//' | awk -F': ' -v t=$t '{print t"\t"$1"\t"$2}'; done
# SMART 8.0+ additions (from the SMART source; see docs/smart-data-model.md, Version differences)
